assumptions: Volume state uses calibrated inventory, measured net delivery and reported pump feedback; commands remain separate.
Level mapping uses the declared piecewise-linear calibration and absolute error bound without extrapolation.
Forecasts hold measured deliveries and pump availability constant unless a candidate explicitly changes an eligible control.
Source potential is inferred as measured net delivery plus the frozen commanded curtailment; its future constancy is an assumption.
Redundant readings must have overlapping absolute bounds; the primary value and bound are retained without averaging.

recommendation.explanation: The lowest-cost validated advisory run is ea0e2b4c-eaad-40f4-9908-06f756b311e3 with cost 5280 synthetic units. It sets backup_pump flow to 35 m³/h, bypass flow to 18.75 m³/h, truck_route flow to 22 m³/h, and source_a curtailment to 0. All tank volumes remain within capacity over the 3‑hour horizon with no violations. The run is validated via native dense reference and has minimum headroom 4.47 m³. request_approval has staged it for operator action; the session cannot apply controls. Caveats: synthetic constant-flow model; quality not evaluated; finite candidate set does not guarantee global optimality; operator must explicitly approve and apply the staged controls.
